page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg8i.6xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated Intel Xeon 6462C vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This server type does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system deployment and data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by an 18 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with the instance.

With its dedicated CPU allocation and 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the instance offers predictable compute resources for general-purpose workloads. The absence of local storage and GPU hardware positions this instance as a cost-efficient option for workloads that do not require hardware acceleration or high-speed local disk I/O. It is suitable for applications such as web serving, application servers, build systems, and general-purpose business applications.
